messages:
Rina M: Quick planning thread We need to finalize what the observability beta contains for customers and what we explicitly mark as "limited".
Owen L: Customers want per-route cost and quick error grouping. Also hearing requests for model-version correlation from integrations.
Priya K: From CS: two early adopters ask for SLO dashboards, a CSV export for billing, and an easy way to tag traces with model_version. Week 5 pilot ask.
Ben T: Engineering constraints: full-span retention is expensive. We should plan for sampling + short raw-span retention (7d) and aggregated metrics for 30d.
Rina M: Draft MVP scope proposal:
- Pre-built dashboard template: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, token spend over time, top routes.
- Cost export: per-route daily token spend CSV + per-model breakdown (top N models).
- Tracing hook: single-insert header for route + model_version, sampled spans on error and adaptive sampling for high QPS routes.
- Error analytics: group by exception signature + model_version, surface 3 redacted examples per group.
Owen L: Implementation notes: prefer header X-RW-Meta: route=/v1/stream;model=redwood-7b;ver=2025-02-14 to avoid multiple headers.
Priya K: Acceptance criteria for pilots (FinRegCo, MedAI):
- They can filter cost by route and model_version
- See correlation between p99 spikes and recent model rollouts
- Click an error group and view example requests with PII redacted
- Download CSV matching their billing window
Ben T: Dev estimates (rough): dashboard template assembly (1.5 sprints), cost pipeline changes (2 sprints), tracing header + sampler (1 sprint), error grouping and UI (2 sprints) -> ~6.5 sprints. Can we compress?
Rina M: If we cut, drop clickable raw-span drilldown and keep the example requests + CSV. That keeps customer-critical items.
Priya K: Customers OK with that trade-off as long as sampling and retention limitations are clearly communicated.
marketing-bot: marketing: please tag any external comms with the phrase "beta observability: sampled traces, limited retention".
Owen L: Policy detail: default sampling = sample-on-error + adaptive upsample when route qps > 50 for that customer. Add per-customer config for pilots.
Ben T: Also we should auto-increase sampling for 30 minutes after a rollout event (model_version change) if enabled. Minimizes missed regressions.
Rina M: Decision: MVP includes dashboard template, per-route CSV export, tracing header for tagging, error grouping with 7-day examples. Stretch: raw-span drilldown and 30d raw-span exports.
Priya K: Action items:
- Owen: write header spec + sampling defaults (due Fri)
- Ben: retention and export design (S3 export path + redaction) (due Mon)
- Rina: beta acceptance checklist + UI disclaimer text draft (due Tue)
- Priya: confirm pilot customer sign-offs and legal redaction constraints (due Tue)
infra-bot: deploy: obs-canary scheduled 02:30 UTC tomorrow; oncall will be pinged.
marketing-bot: I'll draft the short UI blurb and a help doc link.
Owen L: Small note: make model_version an enumerated tag in the pipeline so we can aggregate reliably (no freeform strings).
Ben T: Agree. Structured tag + deny long free-text values.
Rina M: Okay locking this. Web7ll present this to CTL on Wed for go/no-go. Thanks team.
Priya K: +1
Owen L: +1
Ben T: +1
marketing-bot: +1 :sparkles:
